Arriving by car

From the street to your door, in five moves

minutes searching0
  1. 1

    Turn into Dagkli

    Set your sat-nav to «Dagkli 1, Ioannina». You are in the heart of the city, close to Zalongou Square.

  2. 2

    The barrier opens

    The parking entrance is on the ground floor of the building, next to the café. We send you all the instructions before you arrive.

  3. 3

    Under a roof

    The car stays covered inside the building — out of the rain, the snow and the summer sun.

  4. 4

  5. 5

    Take the lift in Building B. The door with the City Spot sign is waiting for you.

The apartment

Two rooms, warm light, everything new

A recently renovated two-room apartment of 30 m² in the city centre: a bedroom with a large double bed, a living room with a sofa bed, a bathroom with a shower, a balcony and a terrace. Ideal for a couple or a small family.

The bedroom

A large double bed with white linen, a soft armchair corner, oak details and warm lamps — for a quiet night after a walk to the Castle. Desk, TV and air-conditioning.

02

The living room

A sofa bed for extra guests, shelves with plants, a TV and a balcony door full of light. In the evening the lamps turn the room golden.

03

The bathroom

A walk-in shower with glass, a hairdryer, fresh towels and free toiletries waiting in a basket.

04

Balcony & terrace

Your morning coffee outside, a little green and the city around you. In the evening the lights on the tree switch on.

Questions

Frequently asked

Is the parking really free?

Yes. The parking space inside the building is included in your stay, with no extra charge.

Where exactly is the parking?

In the same building, Dagkli 1. The entrance with the barrier is on the ground floor, next to the café, and the space is covered. We send you the instructions before you arrive.

What are the check-in and check-out times?

Check-in from 13:00, check-out until 11:00. Please tell us your arrival time in advance.

How many people does it sleep?

There is a large double bed in the bedroom and a sofa bed in the living room — ideal for a couple or a small family. A cot is available on request.

How far is the Castle and the lake?

Ioannina Castle is about 1.2 km away, a pleasant walk through the centre. The museums and Zalongou Square are 350–400 m away.

Are pets allowed?

Yes, on request. A charge may apply — ask us when you book.

Is there a lift, Wi-Fi and air-conditioning?

Yes, all three. Wi-Fi is free.

How do I book?

Send us a booking request by WhatsApp or e-mail from this page, call 697 251 1199, or book on Booking.com.
